description: An elderly bearded man in a white robe and pale turban sits on a wooden cot inside a tent, stitching a small dark cap by candlelight. A gold-hilted sword with a red scabbard and a steel breastplate lie on the carpet at his feet, and stacked books sit on a low table. Through the open tent flap, a night camp with campfires, tents and rocky hills is visible. The style is an oil-painting look, filling the frame edge to edge with no text.
